content: notify-debouncer-full handles rename stitching (From/To matched into single Rename), updates paths of pending events across renames, tracks FS IDs (FSEvents/Windows), and merges high-frequency writes within debounce window. It does NOT provide self-write echo suppression — that must be app-level (register hash/mtime before own writes). Editor atomic-save (tmp write + rename) surfaces as Rename event after the delay.
